name: user-app
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project user-app --web
// e2e marker: The rendered page must contain the configured product brand (shell header + document title), not reference-page copy, so replacing the reference page never touches this target. Rebrand with VITE_PRODUCT_NAME.

options.command: VITE_E2E_COVERAGE=true VITE_API_BASE_URL_MODE=same-origin node_modules/.bin/vite build --config apps/frontend/app/vite.config.mts && node packages/tooling/bin/repo-tooling.mjs testing frontend-browser-e2e-coverage --dist dist/apps/frontend/app --app-name user-app --contains "${VITE_PRODUCT_NAME:-Nest React Boilerplate}" --coverage-dir coverage/e2e/apps/frontend/app && node apps/frontend/app/scripts/assert-browser-coverage.mjs
